title: Value of a Box OAuth refresh token in a token response or refresh request
summary: A synthetic value of the refresh_token member of a pretty-printed token response, and of the refresh_token field in a raw form-encoded refresh request and a curl -d argument.
rationale: The carrier is documented: the Box token endpoint response carries the refresh token in its refresh_token member, and a refresh request passes it as the refresh_token field of an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body with grant_type refresh_token. Box states no prefix, alphabet or length, so the value is flagged because of where it sits, not because of its shape. The extent is the value only: the member or field name, the colon or equals sign, the ampersand and the quotes are outside it, and the client_id beside it is a public identifier.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the string value of the refresh_token member of a token response, or of the refresh_token field of a refresh request, is treated as a credential whatever its shape. Box documents the refresh_token response member and the refresh_token request field (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and a generic attribution are the project's decisions. No subtype is inferred, and no prefix, width or alphabet is claimed.

sources.supports: The refresh token for this access token, which can be used to request a new access token when the current one expires.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
